teams.name: IT Support
teams.description: Handles user-facing technical issues: login problems, account access, password resets, software installation, hardware requests, and general troubleshooting for internal tools.
examples: I can't log into my account
My password reset link isn't working
I need admin access to install software on my laptop
My laptop won't turn on
The VPN keeps disconnecting when I work from home

teams.name: Infrastructure & DevOps
teams.description: Manages servers, cloud infrastructure, deployments, uptime, and outages of internal and customer-facing systems.
examples: The production website has been down for 20 minutes
Our API is returning 500 errors intermittently
We need a new staging environment provisioned
The deployment pipeline is failing on the latest release

teams.name: Billing & Payments
teams.description: Handles customer billing questions, failed transactions, refunds, invoice discrepancies, and payment method issues.
examples: I was charged twice for my subscription this month
My online banking shows a missing transaction
I need a copy of last month's invoice
My payment method was declined but I have funds available
I'd like to request a refund for an accidental purchase

teams.name: Accounts Payable
teams.description: Manages payments the company owes to vendors and contractors, including purchase orders and vendor invoice processing.
examples: Our invoice to your company hasn't been paid yet
We need to update our vendor banking details
When will this purchase order be processed?

teams.name: HR Operations
teams.description: Handles employee records, onboarding, offboarding, leave requests, payroll questions, and benefits enrollment.
examples: I haven't received my paycheck this month
How do I enroll in the company health plan?
I'd like to request parental leave
My employment verification letter is needed for a loan application

teams.name: Recruiting
teams.description: Manages job postings, candidate applications, interview scheduling, and hiring status inquiries.
examples: I applied for a position two weeks ago and haven't heard back
Can you reschedule my interview to next week?
Is the Senior Engineer role still open?

teams.name: Account Management
teams.description: Handles existing customer relationships, contract renewals, upgrades/downgrades, and enterprise pricing questions.
examples: We'd like to upgrade to the enterprise plan
Our contract renewal date is coming up and we have questions
Can we get a custom pricing quote for 500 seats?

teams.name: New Business
teams.description: Handles inbound inquiries from prospective new customers who have not yet purchased.
examples: I'm interested in your product for my company, can someone reach out?
Do you offer a free trial?
What's the difference between your Basic and Pro plans?

teams.name: Contracts & Compliance
teams.description: Handles contract review, data processing agreements, compliance questions, and regulatory inquiries.
examples: We need a signed Data Processing Agreement before proceeding
Can your legal team review this MSA redline?
Are you GDPR compliant?

teams.name: Product Support
teams.description: Handles product usage questions, bug reports, feature requests, and general how-to questions from end users.
examples: How do I export my data to CSV?
I found a bug where the save button doesn't work on mobile
Is there a way to bulk-delete old records?
Can you add a dark mode feature?
